data: Tesla's fiscal 2023 total revenue was about $96.77 billion, up 19% from $81.46 billion in 2022. Gross profit was about $17.66 billion, which works out to a gross margin of roughly 18.2%, down from 25.6% in 2022 as price cuts and a shifting product mix weighed on automotive margins. Operating income was about $8.89 billion, giving an operating margin of roughly 9.2%, compared with $13.66 billion and 16.8% in 2022. These figures come from my recollection of Tesla's 2023 Form 10-K rather than a live lookup, so it's worth confirming them against the filing if you need exact numbers.
